messages:
amy: Heads-up — BigBank POC is seeing intermittent 429s during a bulk embeddings import. Error says 'per-route quota exceeded' even though tenant usage is ~60% of budget. Demo scheduled tomorrow. @matt @sara can you triage?

matt: On it. Can you paste the exact error payload + route and tenant id? Any recent ratecap or reservation changes?

amy: Payload: 429 {"error":"per-route quota exceeded","route":"/v1/embeddings","tenant":"bigbank-tenant-42","request_id":"r-8a3"}. They kicked off ~12 concurrent file imports via the UI. Dashboard shows tenant token budget 40,000,000 and usage 24,000,000. No sales-side config changes.

sara: Looking at infra logs for bigbank-tenant-42. I can see a per-route config: `route_protect` applied for embeddings: `concurrency_limit=5` and `reservation_tokens=10000000`. We also have per-tenant reservation 30000000 configured. Note: reservations are applied before usage checks, which can make effective available tokens smaller.

matt: If concurrency_limit is 5 and they did 12 parallel imports, that would trigger 429s even if token budget looks fine. Who enabled that route_protect rule? Was this part of last week's autoscaler rollout?

sara: It looks like an autoscale/route-protect default that got applied for high-cost routes. It should have been opt-in. I can dump the current route config with `GET /internal/config/tenants/bigbank-tenant-42/routes`. Snippet: 
```
"/v1/embeddings": {"concurrency_limit":5,"reservation_tokens":10000000}
```
We apply concurrency check before accepting concurrent imports, so the spike explains the 429s.

amy: Customer expects imports to autoscale. They need reliability for the demo now — any quick mitigations? Relax reservation or bump concurrency?

matt: Quick fix options: 1) bump `concurrency_limit` for that tenant to 20, 2) enable a short burst window so autoscaler can ramp, or 3) temporarily disable route_protect for the tenant. Bump + burst window seems lowest risk. @sara can you patch?

sara: Patch in progress. Sending `PATCH /internal/config/tenants/bigbank-tenant-42/routes` with `{"concurrency_limit":20,"burst_window_sec":60}`. Response: `200 OK`. Cleared 3 queued import tasks as well. Observability shows the 429 rate falling to 0.

matt: I'll open a follow-up to root cause why route_protect defaults were applied. Creating ticket INF-4721 to track config drift + alert on undocumented per-route reservations.

amy: Perfect — I'll update the customer and confirm. Thanks for the fast turnaround. :pray:

sara: FYI: raising concurrency will increase cost and may bump tail latency. We should sync with pricing/CS to adjust expected billing for the demo if needed.

amy: Customer emailed back — retried imports and reports success. Demo remains on. :tada:
